title: Mixed product route through the first-coordinate pushforward
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-admissibility], with $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, write $a_X:X\to s$, $a_Y:Y\to s$, and take $K,V\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. All tensors and operations are derived over $A$ on these constructible domains. Set $K'=Rf_*K$, $Z_X=X\times_sX$, $Z_Y=Y\times_sY$, $U=Y\times_sX$, $q=f\times f$, $r=f\times\operatorname{id}_X:Z_X\to U$, $\pi:U\to Y$ the first projection, and let $p_i,p_i'$ denote the projections from $Z_X,Z_Y$. Use the exact maps $\operatorname{Ku}_!$ of [def-sf-kv-maps] and the projection transformations of [fix-prop-projection-formula]. Put $W=V\otimes f^*L$ and define
$$E_r(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,\operatorname{id}_X;K,B),\quad J_{Y,X}(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_X;K',B),$$
$$J_X(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_X,a_X;K,B),\quad J_Y(C)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_Y;K',C).$$
For every $B\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ one has
$$J_{Y,X}(B)\circ R\pi_!E_r(B)=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B}^{-1}\circ Rf_!J_X(B).$$
This is an equality of maps from $R\pi_!Rr_!(K\boxtimes B)=Rf_!Rp_{1!}(K\boxtimes B)$ to $K'\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B$. Here the identification $a_X^*=f^*a_Y^*$ is used on the right, and all compact-support composition and tensor comparisons are the specified geometric comparisons.

source.place: Step 3, proof of (a): comparison of the common transpose after applying epsilon_f to the second variable; mixed-product factorization expanded in returned item step 9

proof.text: Fix the input $B$ in the assertion. Write $v:U=Y\times_sX\to X$ for the second projection, and set $N=v^*B$, $M=Ra_{X!}B$, $H=a_Y^*M$. Then $r^*N=p_2^*B$, $\pi r=fp_1$, and $Z_X=X\times_YU$ with projections $p_1,r$. The other two Cartesian squares are $(U,v,\pi,Y,a_X,a_Y)$ and $(Z_X,p_2,p_1,X,a_X,a_X)$. These are identifications of the represented pairs of points, with no assumption that a leg square of a correspondence is Cartesian. Use the geometric six-functor structure supplied in [def-sf-kv-maps]. By [thm-sf-ctf-stability](i),(ii),(iv), $N,M,H$, the external products, and all compact-support images used below belong to the finite-Tor constructible domains. By [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin](ii), these bounded constructible pro-etale objects have etale-origin witnesses, so the domain condition of compact-support composition is satisfied. Use (A4) of [def-sf-datum] to identify $Rf_!K=Rf_*K=K'$, and [thm-sf-comp-composition] to identify $R\pi_!Rr_!=Rf_!Rp_{1!}$ via $\pi r=fp_1$. All comparisons below are these specified comparisons.

source.place: Step 3 (a), mixed-product factorization: geometry and domains

proof.text:
Let $\sigma$ denote the signed tensor symmetry. For a map $u$ and objects $T$ on its target and $F$ on its source, abbreviate the left-handed projection isomorphism by
$$\ell_{u;T,F}=Ru_!(\sigma_{F,u^*T})\circ\operatorname{PF}_{u,F,T}\circ\sigma_{T,Ru_!F}:T\otimes Ru_!F\longrightarrow Ru_!(u^*T\otimes F).$$
This is a notation for the displayed forward composite. Its invertibility is [fix-prop-projection-formula]. All pullback/tensor identifications used in this formula and below are those of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso], including their compatibility with signed symmetry and composition.

source.place: Steps 2 and 4: projection transformations read with tensor symmetry

proof.text:
Denote the compact-support exchanges (A2) of [def-sf-datum] for the three displayed Cartesian squares by
$$c_Y:H\xrightarrow{\sim}R\pi_!N,\qquad c_X:a_X^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{1!}p_2^*B,$$
$$d:f^*R\pi_!N\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{1!}r^*N,\qquad e:\pi^*K'\xrightarrow{\sim}Rr_!p_1^*K.$$
Here $e$ is exchange for $f$ along $\pi$, and $d$ for $\pi$ along $f$; they are different exchanges. Pasting the square for $a_X$ along $a_Y$ with the square for $\pi$ along $f$ gives the square for $a_X$ along $a_X=a_Yf$. Thus the horizontal-pasting equation of [fix-lem-exchanges](2), evaluated at $B$, is exactly
$$c_X=d\circ f^*c_Y,$$
where $a_X^*M=f^*H$ and $r^*N=p_2^*B$. Identity-square exchanges are identities by the same cited clause.

source.place: Step 3 (a): expand the exchanges in the mixed-product factorization

proof.text:
Expand $E_r(B)$ using [def-sf-kv-maps](i). Its relative-product base is $Y\times_sX=U$; the two maps into that base are $r$ and $\mathrm{id}_U$, with objects $p_1^*K$ on $Z_X$ and $N$ on $U$. Clause (iv) of [lem-sf-kunneth-coherence] identifies this relative map with $\operatorname{PF}_{r,p_1^*K,N}^{-1}$. The two target-side exchanges in the definition are $e^{-1}$ in the first factor and identity in the second. Consequently, as a map into $\pi^*K'\otimes N$,
$$E_r(B)=(e^{-1}\otimes1_N)\circ\operatorname{PF}_{r,p_1^*K,N}^{-1}.$$
This identifies the specified product map, rather than choosing an isomorphism of its source and target.

Expand $J_{Y,X}(B)$ and $J_X(B)$ by the same definition [def-sf-kv-maps](i), now for $(\mathrm{id}_Y,a_X)$ and $(\mathrm{id}_X,a_X)$. For the former, the relative base is $Y$, the maps are $\mathrm{id}_Y,\pi$, and the inputs are $K',N$; for the latter the base is $X$, the maps are $\mathrm{id}_X,p_1$, and the inputs are $K,p_2^*B$. Clauses (i),(iv) of [lem-sf-kunneth-coherence] identify their relative-product maps with $\ell_{\pi;K',N}^{-1}$ and $\ell_{p_1;K,p_2^*B}^{-1}$: swap the two factors, use the identity-factor projection formula, and swap the target factors back. The first target exchange in each definition is identity, and the second is $c_Y^{-1}$ or $c_X^{-1}$. Hence
$$J_{Y,X}(B)=(1_{K'}\otimes c_Y^{-1})\circ\ell_{\pi;K',N}^{-1},\qquad J_X(B)=(1_K\otimes c_X^{-1})\circ\ell_{p_1;K,p_2^*B}^{-1}.$$
Both formulas keep exactly the signed symmetries in the definition of $\ell$.

Apply the canonical map of [thm-sf-kunneth-relative] over the base $Y$ to $f:X\to Y$, $\pi:U\to Y$, and the objects $K,N$. Its fibre product is $Z_X$ with projections $p_1,r$. Denote this map by
$$\kappa:R\pi_!Rr_!(p_1^*K\otimes r^*N)\longrightarrow K'\otimes R\pi_!N.$$
The four defining operations in that theorem are: apply $R\pi_!$ to $\operatorname{PF}_{r,p_1^*K,N}^{-1}$, then to $e^{-1}\otimes1$, then remove the factor $\pi^*K'$ by the inverse left-handed projection map for $\pi$. Therefore the expression for $E_r$ obtained in step 4 gives
$$\kappa=\ell_{\pi;K',N}^{-1}\circ R\pi_!E_r(B).$$
In particular step 5 identifies the left side of the asserted identity with $(1_{K'}\otimes c_Y^{-1})\circ\kappa$.

Now expand the relative product with the order $(\pi,f;N,K)$. Its second projection is $p_1$, its inverse exchange is $d^{-1}$, and its outer map is $f$. The signed swap from $U\times_YX$ to $X\times_YU=Z_X$ changes the first inverse projection map into $\ell_{p_1;K,r^*N}^{-1}$; the target swap changes the last one into $\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,R\pi_!N}^{-1}$. Thus the explicit four-operation composite of [thm-sf-kunneth-relative] in this order, after those swaps, is
$$\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,R\pi_!N}^{-1}\circ Rf_!(1_K\otimes d^{-1})\circ Rf_!(\ell_{p_1;K,p_2^*B}^{-1}).$$
Symmetry clause (i) of [lem-sf-kunneth-coherence], applied to these very inputs over $Y$, says this composite equals $\kappa$. This is the comparison between the two orders of integration needed here; the cited lemma includes the Koszul signs, so none are discarded.

source.place: Symmetry clause (i), applied to (f,pi;K,N) over Y

proof.text:
Naturality of the projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula] in its second variable, applied to $c_Y^{-1}:R\pi_!N\to H$, gives
$$(1_{K'}\otimes c_Y^{-1})\circ\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,R\pi_!N}^{-1}=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,H}^{-1}\circ Rf_!(1_K\otimes f^*c_Y^{-1}).$$
Insert the formula of step 7 for $\kappa$. The two adjacent coefficient arrows inside $Rf_!$ compose as
$$(1_K\otimes f^*c_Y^{-1})\circ(1_K\otimes d^{-1})=1_K\otimes(d\circ f^*c_Y)^{-1}=1_K\otimes c_X^{-1}$$
by the exchange-pasting equality of step 3. Combining with step 5 now gives
$$J_{Y,X}(B)\circ R\pi_!E_r(B)=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,H}^{-1}\circ Rf_!\bigl((1_K\otimes c_X^{-1})\circ\ell_{p_1;K,p_2^*B}^{-1}\bigr)=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,H}^{-1}\circ Rf_!J_X(B).$$
Since $H=a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B$, this is the required equality. The source comparison is the one fixed in step 1 and no properness of $a_X,a_Y$, or $\pi$ has been used.

split_report.summary: Expanded the exact mixed-product maps through the relative Kunneth map for (f,pi) over Y. Its existing symmetry lemma compares the two integration orders; exchange pasting and projection-formula naturality then prove the identity. Statement unchanged; no new nodes.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the mixed-product factorization in Step 3 (a) of lem-trf-trace-source-exchange, the common-transpose argument after the second-variable ordinary counit.

tool_uses.why: The comparison equivalence supplies the etale-origin witnesses required by the finite-level compact-support compositor; no coefficient categories are identified silently.
Finite-coefficient pullback, tensor and compact-support preservation check the domains of the mixed-product maps; the proper-compatibility unit does not prove preservation.
The generic geometric compact-support compositor identifies pi r with f p_1, rather than changing the proper-compatibility route.
The geometric projection isomorphism and its naturality supply the two projection conventions and the final coefficient naturality square.
The monoidal pullback constraints preserve the signed symmetries used when writing the two integration orders.
Horizontal pasting and identity normalization of the specified geometric compact-support exchanges give c_X=d f^*c_Y.
The relative-product identity-factor and signed-symmetry clauses, specialized to the existing canonical maps, compare the two orders of integration over Y.
Its explicit four-operation canonical map is expanded for (f,pi) and (pi,f) over Y; it is a generic product calculation within the proper-compatibility route.

Statement unchanged; it is typed at A_{E,n} with f proper and K,B in D^b_ctf, and both sides type-check as maps Rπ_!Rr_!(K⊠B)→K'⊗a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B. I recomputed def-sf-kv-maps(i) for (f,id_X), (id_Y,a_X) and (id_X,a_X). E_r=(e^{-1}⊗1)PF_r^{-1} follows from coherence (iv). J_{Y,X}=(1⊗c_Y^{-1})ℓ_π^{-1} and J_X=(1⊗c_X^{-1})ℓ_{p_1}^{-1} follow from (i)+(iv), also checked by direct expansion. Expanding the four operations of thm-sf-kunneth-relative over Y gives κ=ℓ_π^{-1}Rπ_!E_r for (f,π) and, for (π,f) after the swaps, PF_f^{-1}Rf_!(1⊗d^{-1})Rf_!ℓ_{p_1}^{-1}. These are equal by lem-sf-kunneth-coherence(i), Koszul signs included. The pasting c_X=d∘f^*c_Y is fix-lem-exchanges(2) with g=a_Y, h=f. Second-variable naturality of PF finishes the proof, with the arrows in the right order. Edge cases f=id, B=0, K=0, X empty, the point case, non-proper X=A^1 and shifts all pass. No new nodes; no duplicate (lem-trf-product-projection-comparison is a different identity); no cycle (checked by transitive closure); no SGA cited. The 12 searches cover all three kinds.
